summary: CION Investment Corp. filed an 8-K on July 15, 2026, reporting the issuance of $30 million in senior unsecured notes at initial closing. The 7.50% 2029 Notes were issued at 98.00% of par, and the 8.00% 2031 Notes at 97.00% of par. Proceeds will repay outstanding debt and for general corporate purposes. This is a routine debt financing, not a special situation.
